findings.text: No test proves that a career page redirected (res.url on another origin) to an origin whose robots.txt is Disallow: / makes the company skipped; the cross-origin re-check in FallbackEngine.extractJobs (and fetchAndExtractHtml) is untested. fallbackEngine.test.js and adapters.test.js named in the AC were not changed.
enrichCrawler.test.js only uses 'User-agent: *' robots; no test shows a 'User-agent: CleanTechHub / Disallow: /' group blocks crawlCompanySite (guard built with userAgent 'CleanTechHub').
robotsGuard.test.js has no timeout/abort test for the 5 s AbortController path in fetchRobotsTxtWithRedirectCap; only 503 and redirect-overflow cases cover robots_unreachable.

findings.ac: Path/Stress: enrichment redirect cap 5 via safeFetch
findings.text: Spec requires safeFetch(url, { maxRedirects: 5 }) for enrichment robots fetches, but createRobotsGuard calls fetchImpl(currentUrl, { redirect:'manual', ... }) without maxRedirects; safeFetch (default maxRedirects = 3, follows redirects internally) throws on the 4th hop so 4-5 hop chains become robots_unreachable. Untested.
No test that an HTML soft-404 body (2xx with no valid directives) parses to an empty allow-all ruleset in parseRobotsTxt/createRobotsGuard.

findings.ac: Path (enrichment): re-check final origin after redirect
findings.text: crawlCompanySite fetchPage never inspects the final response URL or re-checks guard.isAllowed after safeFetch followed a cross-origin redirect; required behavior is absent from code and tests.

No parseRobotsTxt/createRobotsGuard test has 'User-agent: CleanTechHub-JobIngestion / Disallow: /'; the closest test gives the UA group Allow /careers and * Disallow /careers, not a blanket UA disallow.
Only equal-length Allow/Disallow (/jobs) is tested; no case where a longer Allow overrides a shorter Disallow (the existing Allow /careers vs Disallow /careers/private has the Disallow longer).

findings.ac: AC2 two companies one origin -> one robots fetch
findings.text: Caching is proven only at guard level (fetchCount 1); no runAtsIngestionBatch test with two companies on one origin counting robots fetches, and the AC's named files fallbackEngine.test.js/adapters.test.js were not touched.

parseRobotsTxt picks the first matching group in Map insertion order using targetToken.includes(ua), not the most specific; a 'cleantechhub' group listed before 'cleantechhub-jobingestion' wins, and no test covers multiple matching groups.
runAtsIngestionBatch skip test asserts result.skipped and fakeClient.from not called but never asserts result.failures is empty; fallback test likewise does not assert failures for skipped companies.
Tests only assert hasTdmReservation boolean and that IngestionSkipError is thrown; none asserts reason 'tdm_reserved' on the skipped entry.
